facts.statement: The estimated body length of Spectrovenator ranges from 1.42 to 2.2 meters.
facts.quote: Spectrovenator is a small abelisaurid with an estimated body length of 1.42 - 2.2 m.

facts.statement: The authors conclude that only abelisaurids living after the Cenomanian period possessed the adaptations necessary for the group's characteristic feeding strategy.
facts.quote: The authors conclude that based on the number of basal traits exhibited by Spectrovenator, only the post-Cenomanian abelisaurids had the necessary adaptations for abelisaurids' characteristic feeding strategy.

facts.statement: Spectrovenator ragei is the first basal abelisaurid from the Early Cretaceous known to have a complete skull.
facts.quote: S. ragei es el primer abelisáurido del Cretácico inferior conocido por un cráneo completo.

facts.statement: It is hypothesized that the large foramina on Spectrovenator's skull roof represent blood vessels and nerves related to the lateral nasal and supraorbital vessels and the trigeminal nerve.
facts.quote: Se ha planteado la hipótesis de que representan la presencia de vasos sanguíneos y nervios, probablemente relacionados con el paso de los vasos nasales laterales y supraorbitarios y el nervio trigémino.

facts.statement: The species name ragei honors French paleontologist Jean-Claude Rage for his work on continental Mesozoic vertebrate paleobiogeography.
facts.quote: The specific epithet ragei is named in honor of the French paleontologist Jean-Claude Rage for his contribution to the study on the continental Mesozoic vertebrate paleobiogeography.

facts.statement: Spectrovenator lived at the boundary between the Barremian and Aptian stages, approximately 125 million years ago, in what is now South America.
facts.quote: que vivió a principios del período Cretácico, en el límite entre el Barremiense y el Aptiense, hace 125 millones de años, en lo que hoy es, Sudamérica.

facts.statement: The time range for Spectrovenator is the Aptian stage, from 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Fossils of Spectrovenator ragei were discovered in the Quiricó Formation, part of the Areado Group in Minas Gerais, Brazil, under the holotype of the sauropod Tapuiasaurus macedoi.
facts.quote: Fue descubierto en la formación Quiricó, parte del grupo Areado en el estado de Minas Gerais, Brasil, los fósiles de S. ragei se descubrieron bajo el holotipo del saurópodo Tapuiasaurus macedoi.

facts.statement: The genus Spectrovenator and the species S. ragei were described by Zaher et al. in 2020.
